title: Eden Care Welcomes Three New Board Members
summary: Eden Care offers tailored group health insurance plans for SMEs and corporates in Rwanda. Our digital solutions and 'ProActiv' wellness app ensure seamless healthcare experiences
body_markdown:
**Kigali, Rwanda – 19th October 2026** - Eden Care Healthcare (Rwanda) Ltd is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. David Marc Munyanziza, Mr. Gary Gael Imanzi, and Prof. Jeannine Uwimana Nicol to its Rwanda Board.


The appointments strengthen Eden Care's leadership as the company continues its mission of making healthcare more accessible, affordable, simple, fast, and stress-free in Rwanda and beyond.


## David Marc Munyanziza — Board Member


Mr. David Marc Munyanziza brings over 17 years of experience in financial technology, digital innovation, business development, and management. He currently serves as Head of Digital Experience at I&M Bank (Rwanda) PLC, leading digital transformation and customer experience initiatives. Previously, he held roles at Unicel Congo, Vodacom DRC, Rwanda Bankers Association, and Sybrin Systems. He holds a Master's Degree in International Business from Oklahoma Christian University and a Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Money and Banking from the University of Rwanda. His expertise will support Eden Care's continued growth and innovation.


## Gary Gael Imanzi — Board Member


Mr. Gary Gael Imanzi brings over six years of experience in finance, audit, assurance, and climate finance. He currently serves as a Climate Finance Specialist at the Rwanda Green Fund, following experience in external and internal audit at PwC Rwanda, including work with regulated insurance and banking institutions. His expertise in financial reporting, risk management, governance, and strategic implementation will strengthen the Board's perspective.


## Prof. Jeannine Uwimana Nicol — Board Member


Prof. Jeannine Uwimana Nicol is a public health specialist, researcher, and academician with over a decade of experience in health systems, health policy, epidemiology, and evidence-based healthcare. She is an Associate Professor at Stellenbosch University and the University of Rwanda and has worked with organisations including WHO, UNICEF, USAID, EGPAF, and the Rwanda Ministry of Health. Her expertise will bring valuable public health and healthcare systems insight to the Board.


## With Appreciation


Eden Care also extends its sincere appreciation to Ms. Adeline Muhoza Nzitatira, who concludes her tenure on the Eden Care Board. We thank her for her leadership, contribution, and commitment to Eden Care's journey and wish her continued success in all that lies ahead.


Eden Care looks forward to the experience, perspectives, and leadership of its new Board members as it continues building the future of healthcare in Rwanda and beyond.


## About Eden Care


Eden Care Healthcare (Rwanda) Ltd is committed to making quality healthcare more accessible and delivering a simple, fast, and stress-free healthcare experience.
